column1: # Which branch is which, declared once (#326).
# Format: constant<TAB>branch name
# The INTEGRATION branch is the repository's default branch: every pull
# request targets it, a newer push to it supersedes the run in flight, the
# nightly runs the full selftest on it, and Pages publishes from it.
# A pull request into it and a push to it run no selftest
# (.github/gate-budget.tsv's `selftest_events`, #369). Everything that RUNS
# reads it as the default branch -- `github.event.repository.default_branch`
# in a workflow, `origin/HEAD` or
# `gh repo view --json defaultBranchRef` in a script -- never from here. Its
# row exists for scripts/check-ci-coverage.py alone: a `branches:` list cannot
# take an expression, so the triggers spell it, and the check compares that
# spelling to this row (ruled on #326, comment 5972929414, Q2).
# The RELEASE branch takes only release pull requests from the integration
# branch. A pull request into it and a push to it run the full selftest on
# `max_shards`, never cancelled and never scoped. Read from here by
# scripts/scope-selftest.py --kind and scripts/gatelib.py; spelled twice
# more, in verify.yml's `cancel-in-progress` expression and its `selftest`
# job's `if:`, which cannot read a file, and checked against this row there
# Renaming either branch is an edit to this file, the trigger lists, and
# those two expressions, together; check-ci-coverage.py refuses any of them
# left behind.
integration_branch
release_branch
